daily.title: Daily puzzle
daily.alreadyText: Come back tomorrow for a new one, or keep sharp with Puzzle Rush.
daily.about: Everyone gets the same puzzle on the same date, and a new one at local midnight. Weekends are harder. Any attempt keeps your streak going.

rush.title: Puzzle Rush
rush.endStrikes: Three strikes. Puzzles get harder the further you go.
rush.endTime: Time is up. Puzzles get harder the further you go.
rush.notRated: Puzzle Rush counts for the leaderboards, not your puzzle rating: the daily puzzle and drills move your rating.
rush.leaveBody: Leaving ends the run now with %{n} solved. It is recorded, and it counts as today's run.
rush.loadingNext: Getting the next puzzle from the game server…
rush.lost: The connection to the game server was lost, so the run ended here. It is not ranked.

defence.intro: Someone looks close to winning. Keep your shape, but which discard is safest?
defence.threatFour: %{n} sets exposed: one step from winning
defence.threatThree: %{n} sets exposed and a long discard row
defence.verdicts: If they are ready, how often each tile you can throw wins for them

claim.wrong: The coach would do something else.

value.intro: Several discards leave you ready. Which one is worth the most?

foot.title: Your puzzle record
foot.tip1: Tip: count the tiles you can still draw. A wait on four live tiles beats a prettier wait on one.
foot.tip2: Tip: break up isolated honours early; keep tiles that connect to pairs and runs.
foot.tip3: Tip: when an opponent has three melds out, the tiles they already discarded are your safest.
